summary: Iter 35 — Full regression on the 3 user-reported Customer Display sync/reset bugs. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases green (session-reset on apt change, session-reset on step=select+no apt, auto-idle PERSISTS in DB for stale receipt, live-preview categories roundtrip, DELETE full reset, plus auth cookie regression). Frontend: 5/5 live-sync UI checks green via Playwright + direct API push (cd-idle after DELETE, live category propagation, live amount update, receipt→idle on reset, select+null→idle, apartment swap clears old method screen).
critical_code_review_comments: PayScreen on CustomerDisplay.jsx maps category keys to a fixed set of Dutch labels (Maandhuur / Servicekosten / Boetes / Internet). When the operator pushes a category with a custom label like 'Huur Jul', the customer screen shows the static 'Maandhuur' label rather than the operator-supplied label. This is by design for clean presentation, but worth noting: if the product wants the operator's exact label to show, PayScreen needs to fall back to the payload label. NOT BLOCKING.

CustomerDisplay.jsx is 845 lines — still over the 700-line soft limit raised in iter34. Splitting Idle/Greet/Overview/Pay/Method/Receipt into separate files is recommended for maintainability. Not blocking iter35 fixes.

Backend update_customer_display has nicely scoped session_reset detection (apt_changed OR step in {idle,check,select}). Code is readable and correctly clears method_chosen_at, customer_initiated, and mope_* QR fields on reset. Auto-idle in public GET now writes back to mongo — verified by direct DB inspection in tests. Implementation is solid.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 user-reported bugs are FIXED and validated end-to-end: (1) Klantenscherm reset bij appartement-wissel — session_reset detection in PUT /api/kiosk/customer-display correctly fires when apt.id changes OR step transitions to idle/check/select, clearing method_chosen_at + customer_initiated + mope_* fields. UI: operator on OLD method screen → switch to NEW apartment → cd-overview renders for NEW within ~2s, no stale method screen. (2) Uni5Pay QR stale data — same session_reset clears mope_qr/mope_ref/mope_mode/mope_amount/mope_currency on apt change or step=idle/select. Also, the QR fields are now ONLY preserved while step ∈ {confirm,receipt} AND not session_reset, so during method-pick or overview no stale QR persists. (3) Live preview categories — PUT step=pay with categories[] roundtrips intact through public GET; customer screen re-renders within ~2s via the 1.5s poll. Verified Borg category and amount update flow live. ALSO VERIFIED: DELETE /api/kiosk/customer-display fully resets to {step:'idle'} (no payload), and effectiveStep on the frontend correctly maps step='select' with no apartment to 'idle' so customer never sees an empty Greet between tenants. Auto-idle for stale receipt (>12s) now PERSISTS to mongo — verified via direct pymongo inspection after the public GET fires.

rca_of_the_issue: n/a — all 3 user-reported issues are FIXED and verified. The fix architecture is: (a) session_reset in update_customer_display PUT handler clears all locks when apt changes or step goes idle/check/select; (b) auto-idle in public GET now writes the reset back to mongo so the next operator PUT starts from a clean slate; (c) frontend KioskLayout reset() calls DELETE /api/kiosk/customer-display for immediate customer-screen reset; (d) effectiveStep maps select+no-apt to idle so the customer never sees an empty Greet between tenants; (e) livePreview onLiveChange in PaySelect pushes operator's category/amount selections via PUT for ~500ms-2s live propagation.
